title: Key Press Duration (seconds)
desc: Specify the amount of time EDCoPilot will hold down a key when emulating keybind presses (default is 0.15 seconds)

title: Additional Pause Duration After Opening Galaxy Map (Odyssey) (seconds)
desc: Specify an additional amount of time in seconds to pause after opening the Galaxy Map before attempting remainder of course plot key presses

title: Write Last Spoken text to file
desc: If ON, EDCoPilot will write its last spoken phrase to the file (EDCoPilot)/working/EDCoPilot.LastSpoken.txt

title: Use direction of travel when calculating heading to target
desc: If ON, will use your direction of travel, if OFF will use the heading you are facing

title: Use direction of travel above preferred speed
desc: If ON, will only use your direction of travel when travelling over the preferred speed

title: Min speed to use direction of travel
desc: Specify the speed at which the heading calculation will switch to use direction of travel intead of the direction you are facing

title: Use direction of travel ONLY when in SRV
desc: If ON, will only use your direction of travel to calculate the heading to the target when you are in your SRV

title: Log time trial status updates to csv files
desc: If ON, will log status updates to a csv file in (EDCoPilot)/logs folder, for each time trial attempt

title: Delete status csv files if > x days old
desc: Housekeeps the time trial csv files if older than the specified number of days (unless number of logs is less than the minimum number to be kept). Use 0 if you wish to keep them all

title: Minimum number of status csv files to keep
desc: Set this if you wish to keep at least this number of status csv files from being automatically deleted

title: Export time trial definition files
desc: If ON, will export the time trial definition file to (EDCoPilot)/logs folder, when you click start on a time trial from the leaderboard screen
